mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_favorite (user_id, doc_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS noteId, d.title AS title, d.type AS type,
LEFT(d.content, 100) AS content, k.name AS kbName, uf.created_at AS favoritedAt FROM user_favorite uf
LEFT JOIN document d ON uf.doc_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN knowledge_base k ON d.kb_id = k.id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC
